_about: Elements found on the live pages on 2026-10-25 (@downloads/discovery/pages.json). Identity always comes from a link's href, not from text.

video_tile.description: A video tile on Home, channel pages and the watch sidebar (42 on Home, 32 on the channel page, 40 in the sidebar).

tile_link.description: Links inside a tile; the largest one wraps the thumbnail (yt-thumbnail-view-model).

inline_preview.description: After ~2 s of hover the preview player (#inline-preview-player) covers the thumbnail; elementFromPoint returns its <video>. It carries a link to the same video.

watch_page.description: Watch page root; attribute video-id is the playing video.

main_player.description: The main player (990x557 at the default layout).

sidebar.description: Right column with suggested video tiles.

save_button.name: Save to playlist
save_button.description: Opens the Save dialog; clicking it makes YouTube send playlist/get_add_to_playlist. Not used by the extension (it uses the request directly). Moves into the overflow menu on narrow windows.

playlist_entry.description: One entry on a playlist page; contains a link with v=ID.
